title: WebGPU Occlusion Queries in Rust: Visibility with wgpu
description: Build a WebGPU visibility test in Rust with two native occlusion queries, asynchronous result readback, a translucent occluder, and a browser-safe fallback.
imageAlt: A translucent blue WebGPU occluder separating a dark teapot from a partly visible green sphere, with sample counts shown in an overlay.
